questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code uses encryption for the stored video segments? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
How are title keys protected before they are stored through KeyRegistry?
choices: They are stored as plain bytes, since the registry is internal
They are hashed with SHA-256 so they cannot be read back
They are encrypted with the master key from the PKCS12 keystore using AES-GCM with a fresh random IV prepended to the blob
They are encrypted with the title's first segment nonce

questions.prompt: What effect does the AAD (rendition + "/" + segmentIndex) have on a stored segment file?
choices: It is encrypted together with the segment and stored in the file
Decryption fails if a sealed segment is presented under a different rendition or index than the one it was sealed for
It makes the nonce unique for each rendition
It compresses the segment before encryption

questions.prompt: Which transport protections does LicenseServerClient enforce when calling the license server?
choices: TLS 1.3 only, with certificate and hostname verification against the supplied trust store, and a client certificate for mutual authentication
Any TLS version the JVM supports, since the SSLContext is created with the default protocol
TLS 1.3 with the server certificate checking disabled, because a client certificate is presented
Plain HTTP unless the endpoint URI starts with https
